title.zh: 小型化智能葱类作物收获机器人

summary.zh: 面向葱类作物收获场景，集成松土、输送、分拣、视觉定位与自主导航的移动机器人。
summary.en: A mobile robot integrating soil loosening, transport, sorting, visual localization and autonomous navigation for scallion harvesting.

resumeSummary.zh: 自主设计一种智能葱类作物收获机器人，该机器人由松土系统、输送系统、分拣系统等组成。创新设计了松土机构、挠性传输机构和双死点连杆机构；利用 YOLOv5 实现对葱类作物质量分拣，通过 ORB-SLAM3 完成建图与定位，基于 EXG 与改进贯序聚类方法实现作物行视觉识别，利用改进的人工势场法进行路径规划。
resumeSummary.en: Independently designed an intelligent scallion harvesting robot composed of soil-loosening, transport and sorting systems. Innovated loosening, flexible transport and double-dead-point linkage mechanisms; used YOLOv5 for scallion quality sorting, ORB-SLAM3 for mapping and localization, ExG with improved sequential clustering for crop-row vision, and an improved artificial potential field method for path planning.

challenge.zh: 葱类作物形态细长、种植行间环境复杂，机器人需要在有限尺寸内同时完成低损松土、连续输送、质量分拣和田间自主移动。
challenge.en: Scallions are slender and field rows are visually complex. The robot had to combine low-damage loosening, continuous transport, quality sorting and autonomous motion within a compact platform.

zh: 设计松土机构、挠性传输机构与双死点连杆机构，形成收获作业链。
使用 YOLOv5 完成作物质量分拣，使用 ORB-SLAM3 完成建图与定位。
基于 EXG 与改进贯序聚类识别作物行，并用改进人工势场法规划路径。
en: Designed loosening, flexible transport and double-dead-point linkage mechanisms as an integrated harvesting chain.
Applied YOLOv5 for quality sorting and ORB-SLAM3 for mapping and localization.
Detected crop rows with ExG and improved sequential clustering, then planned motion with an improved artificial potential field method.

zh: 负责整体机构设计、机器人模型与动画渲染。
实现作物行识别并部署 ORB-SLAM3-ROS2。
完成下位机电路、PCB 焊接、STM32 控制与物联网云平台 UI。
en: Led mechanism design, robot modeling and animation rendering.
Implemented crop-row perception and deployed ORB-SLAM3 with ROS2.
Built lower-controller electronics, soldered the PCB, programmed STM32 control and designed the IoT dashboard UI.

outcome.zh: 完成整机原型与多模块联调；相关收获机构成果获得国家发明专利授权。
outcome.en: Completed the integrated prototype and multi-module testing; related harvesting mechanism work received a granted national invention patent.
